review.imagery: 46 gallery entries include 8 dated site photographs. All 26 primary assets, the complete 41-page brochure index, twenty native resources and eight September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Two exact primary repeats, four native textures and repeated lobby/bathroom angles were excluded. Fourteen brochure scenes add project-branded lobby, gym, duplex and bathroom views. Some interiors also appear in other Imtiaz marketing and retain shared-design concept scope. Original scene typography remains intact. The full street building supplies card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All thirteen complete physical pages 2–14 were visually reviewed on four contacts. Original margins, grouped levels, duplex relationships and pool legends are preserved. The inspected broker page has no openly displayed floor-plan section. No hidden or form-gated image was retrieved. No numerical home area was inferred from a level drawing. Thirteen complete building sheets retain the grouped levels, duplex portions, roof pools and source legends. No numerical individual saleable areas are printed. Upper and lower duplex portions are not separate whole homes. Confirm contractual home areas and final drawings with Imtiaz.
review.location: Complete original brochure pages 5–7 were rendered at 3200 pixels. Map 5 and the actual prose schedule on page 6 were visually read. Logo-only contextual destinations were not assigned times. The official embed explicitly names a DMS coordinate marker, independently decoded and converted. Its different camera-centre numbers were excluded. Island masterplans and sun/view diagrams remain proposed context.
review.provenance: Official HTML/gallery and September 2026 history pages retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Branded brochure and complete building drawings retain Mitchell’s broker-mirror attribution. Public unit previews, where available, retain their separately observed broker image URLs. Full source bytes and notices remain intact. Original text research and protected identities are preserved.

unavailable: Individual contractual saleable areas, detailed independent home sheets, exact visitor entrance, guaranteed home outlook, current certified site progress and final specifications remain unavailable or unverified.
